answer: Each identity enrolls a gait profile from 14 days of phone accelerometer signal, hashed into the lotus registry as one template. Each epoch a 30-second walk must match 0.93 in 10 minutes, backed by a 20 POA bond locked 90 days; a bridge check ties samples to the phone key. Two failures forfeit half the bond, freeze payouts 3 epochs. 100 fakes need 100 walkers at 40 POA each, 4,000 POA, plus 2,000 POA locked, fees doubling every 50 hires; one honest walker pays 20 POA. A sprained ankle gets 7-day grace re-enrollment, not a slash. Verifiers replay signed samples and match logs on-chain.
